sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 10 / C11; Internal Quality Checks row 10 / C11, no annotation cells filled; Deterministic Checks check-canonical-shared-files.py, check-dockerfiles.py, check-rubric-schema.py, check-allowlist-matches-provider.py)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (task.toml, tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/.dockerignore, tests/tools, five judge.toml)
evidence: Isolation: task/task.toml:26-28 sets [verifier] environment_mode = "separate" (timeout_sec 13200.0, unchanged from the template); task.toml:37-38 [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public", no allowed_hosts anywhere (correct per SKILL.md:26). Credentials: task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] is REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "" - identical to the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md:66-71. A diff of task.toml against the frozen template differs only in lines 5-7, 10-12 and 14-15 (name, description, keywords, difficulty, explanation, category, provenance, arena_slice); everything from [agent] down is byte-identical, the file is LF-only ASCII. No secret literal: a grep of the task for glm|openrouter|ANTHROPIC_|API_KEY|allowed_hosts|sk-or-|REWARDKIT_ hits only task.toml:31-35 and the guard at tests/test.sh:63-64. Pinning: tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (diff empty); bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim (lines 1-2), npm globals all @version pinned (lines 17-21: claude-code 2.1.281, codex 0.151.0, @playwright/mcp 0.0.79, express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1), pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31), Chromium installed through the pinned Playwright CLI (lines 33-35), COPY . /tests at line 43. tests/test.sh, tests/.dockerignore and tests/tools are also identical to the template. Unpinned apt packages (lines 12-14) are template-controlled and a NOTE-only matter under check-dockerfiles.py; base images are tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned, exactly as the shared template ships them. judge.toml: all five files carry only judge = "claude-code" at line 2 (the expected fallback) with mode/timeout/isolated/prompt_template; a grep for model|glm|openrouter|api_key|auth_token|reasoning|temperature|effort finds nothing in any of them; the only weight keys are per-criterion weights. Runtime corroboration (earlier candidate, not these bytes): raw-evidence-index hashes for result.json (4a9b1934...) and verifier/reward.json (bcfe3714...) re-computed and match; verifier/scored/reward-details.json records model z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx for the three scored suites and reward 0.9833, showing the same unchanged block authenticates and grades on the hosted verifier. No configured-judge run exists for these exact bytes; that gap is not required for this static wiring row because the verifier block, tests/Dockerfile and test.sh are unchanged from the template. Adversarial probes: a broken variant (model or key added to a judge.toml, edited env block, real key literal, environment_mode shared) would be visible in the diffs/greps above and none is present; a conforming alternative (judge fallback in judge.toml, no allowlist) is not penalised.
